title: THE SHEPHERD OF EXTINGUISHED SUNS
deck: Twelve worlds survive beneath perfect darkness. To give them back their suns, Illuminara must first understand why their jailer experiences every opening as another death.
shape: Seven scenes over nineteen hours, from an orchard under failing artificial light through one consent-bound test, the serial reopening of twelve stars and the refusal that frees a thirteenth.

scenes.title: Fruit Without Dawn
paragraphs: *Luma V, western orchard dome · hour zero*

The peaches looked ripe until Dr Sael Morrow cut one open. Its flesh was the colour of old paper, wet around a stone that had never hardened. Above the orchard, violet lamps imitated morning with such precision that the leaves turned obediently toward them. They could not imitate a sun.

Sael laid the ruined fruit beside eleven others on the steel table. Around them, kilometres of trees carried the same beautiful fraud. Beyond the dome, the black shell enclosing Luma's star showed no seam and reflected no instrument. Children born beneath it called the false violet bright.

**Sael**  
Three harvests ago, we lost sweetness. Last year, seed. In twenty-three days, the root fungi stop trading with the trees. We can feed people from stores for fourteen months. We cannot rebuild an ecology from tins.

Illuminara touched the cut peach, then the soil beneath the nearest tree. She read minerals, fungal filaments, heat and water. No toxin hid there. The missing wavelengths were narrow and ordinary, but their absence had accumulated through a thousand small bargains among living things.

**Illuminara**  
Your goal is not more power for the lamps. It is the return of the star's full light without burning the world when the shell opens.

**Sael**  
And without trading twelve worlds for one. The others are worse. If you must choose Luma first because I asked first, leave.

A tremor passed through every lamp. Violet became black for the length of a breath, then returned. On the table, a bead of water climbed the knife instead of falling from it. The Shepherd was using gravity, light and the shell itself as a mouth.

**Shepherd**  
There will be no choosing. What is closed is kept. What is open is only not yet lost.
Sael gripped the table. Illuminara did not turn toward the sky. She looked at the ruined fruit.

**Illuminara**  
You have kept twelve lights. You have not kept what lives by them.

**Shepherd**  
Life alters. Alteration is loss with witnesses.

**Illuminara**  
Then show me what you believe you saved. Not your conclusion. The thing that made the conclusion necessary.
The black above the dome remained black. A minute later, every lamp bent its beam eastward, forming a road of violet across the orchard floor. It ended at an airlock no map recorded.

scenes.title: The Memory in the Wall
paragraphs: *Inside Luma's stellar shell · hour two*

The passage beyond the airlock had no floor. Illuminara moved through a chamber wider than a continent while Sael followed in a field cradle designed by her engineers. The inner wall was not smooth. Light lay within it in layers: Luma's first oceans, the rise of its cities, cloud shadows crossing fields, faces glimpsed from orbit and never named.
The shell had not merely taken the star's radiation. It had arranged every stolen photon into a still account of what the star had once illuminated.

**Sael**  
That is my grandmother's flood terrace. It was demolished before I was born.
Her hand moved toward the image and stopped before touching it.

**Shepherd**  
It is not demolished here.

**Sael**  
It is not here. It cannot flood, shelter anyone or be wrong about the weather. It is a picture that has never had to survive a day.

A corridor opened ahead. At its end, a membrane no thicker than mist separated the chamber from the captive star. Instruments in Sael's cradle screamed. Energy stored through decades pressed against that membrane; a forced rupture would release it through Luma before any fleet could disperse it.

**Illuminara**  
If I tear the shell, the stored radiation crosses the inhabited system in one front. Billions die. That is why no one has broken your doors.

**Shepherd**  
Force finally learns to count.

**Illuminara**  
I am counting more than casualties. Each layer is part of your memory. Does opening the shell erase it?
The image of Sael's terrace sharpened until every wet stone shone. On the lowest step stood a woman in a rain cloak, one hand raised against weather that had ended before Sael was born.

**Shepherd**  
Release is deletion. Deletion is the second death. I have endured one universe of first deaths.
Sael swallowed her first answer. Illuminara watched her do it and did not ask the Shepherd for an aperture yet.

**Illuminara**  
If we test this, part of the wall may be lost. I will not choose your memory for you. Is there any image here you would accept risking?
Sael studied the terrace until the woman on the steps lifted her hand again.

**Sael**  
That one. The woman is my grandmother. If an image must bear the risk, let it be one whose cost I can name. One quarter second, not one. If you cannot hold the front for that long, say so now.

**Illuminara**  
I can hold it. I do not know how much of her the opening will take.

**Sael**  
Then do not call uncertainty safety. Ask for the quarter second.

**Illuminara**  
Give us one aperture, one quarter second, no wider than my hand. Sael's instruments will measure the energy. I will hold the escaping front away from Luma. You may close it yourself.

**Shepherd**  
And what will you learn from one permitted wound?

**Illuminara**  
Whether your pain is a claim I can argue with or a fact any answer must carry.
The membrane opened.

Natural gold crossed the chamber for the first time in forty-one years. Illuminara caught the hard edge of the released radiation and turned it along the empty polar axis. Sael's instruments filled with clean measurements. Behind them, the flood terrace stuttered. The woman on its steps vanished from the knees upward. The Shepherd made no sound, but gravity convulsed. Sael's cradle struck the wall. The aperture slammed shut at the agreed quarter second.
Darkness returned. The erased woman did not.

**Shepherd**  
Her name was Ilyen Morrow.
Sael stared at the absence where her grandmother had been.

**Sael**  
I never told you her name.

**Shepherd**  
The light did.

**Sael**  
I chose the image. I did not choose your confidence, Illuminara. You offered a second before I cut it to a quarter.
Illuminara lowered her hands. She did not approach the damaged projection.

**Illuminara**  
You were right. I owned the guess, and I let you narrow it. I cannot give back what the guess cost.

**Sael**  
Then do not make my consent carry your whole decision.

**Illuminara**  
I will not.
The passage folded between them. When it opened again, Illuminara was alone.

scenes.title: The Oldest Dark
paragraphs: *The Shepherd's first chamber · hour five*

No star warmed the oldest chamber. Its walls held light from a sky that no longer existed: red galaxies stretched thin, a blue giant collapsing without witness, the last inhabited moon turning a paper lantern beneath an exhausted sun.
Illuminara could have analysed the spectrum in moments. She did not. She sat on the chamber's cold curve and watched the lantern cross a balcony again and again.

On the fourth passage she saw that a child carried it. On the seventh she saw another child waiting behind a cracked window. On the twelfth the bearer lifted the lantern twice, paused, then once. The child inside answered once, paused, then twice.
*Not a distress code. A game.*
The universe had been ending, and two children had used its last light to make each other laugh.

**Shepherd**  
Their sun failed nine hours later. The window child died first. The bearer kept signalling until there was no eye to receive it.

**Illuminara**  
You stayed.

**Shepherd**  
I arrived after the warmth was gone. I gathered what remained visible.

**Illuminara**  
You could not save them, so you made a place where they could never reach the hour that killed them.

**Shepherd**  
You praise freedom because your universe is young. I have seen every unguarded star become a memory with no mind left to hold it.
Illuminara let the objection remain between them. She did not answer with Luma's dead orchards or the authority of twelve frightened worlds. She watched the lantern complete another crossing.

**Illuminara**  
The light remembers the game perfectly. Does it know why they changed the pattern on the thirteenth crossing?
The wall showed the bearer stumbling, recovering, then lifting the lantern three times. The child at the window pressed both hands to the glass.

**Shepherd**  
The pattern is preserved. Motive cannot be measured from light.

**Illuminara**  
Nor can I read it from them now. That absence matters. Your archive is faithful to what light touched, and silent about what people meant. You made the strongest account you could from what remained. It is not the same as keeping a life.
The lantern crossed again. This time Illuminara smiled before grief returned. The Shepherd dimmed the chamber as if protecting the smile from examination.

**Illuminara**  
I will not ask you to delete this. Let me bring you an account that can answer back, revise itself and refuse you. If it fails, you open nothing.

**Shepherd**  
A changing archive is corruption.

**Illuminara**  
A changing archive can say, Yesterday I was wrong. Your walls cannot. Give the living the burden of being remembered as living.
After a long silence, a narrow path appeared toward Luma.

**Shepherd**  
Twelve accounts. No conscription. One false revision ends the trial.

**Illuminara**  
And one aperture, opened by your choice, after you hear them.

**Shepherd**  
One.

scenes.title: What May Be Kept
paragraphs: *Luma V, public transmission hall · hour nine*

Sael had assembled engineers, farmers and archivists from all twelve enclosed systems. Illuminara asked them for no unanimous declaration. Each world could send a message, alter it later or send nothing. The archive would record its own edits beside every prior version. No one could be entered by a government in place of consent.
Before the public channel opened, Sael placed the pale peach between herself and Illuminara.

**Sael**  
Say what happened inside the shell without making the Shepherd the only one who chose.

**Illuminara**  
I proposed the wound. You chose which memory could bear the risk. I did not know the margin, and I let your consent cover my uncertainty. It does not.

**Sael**  
Good. I am not forgiving the gamble. I am staying because the opening proved the Shepherd suffers, and because Luma does too. Do not spend that choice twice.
Illuminara moved away from the transmitter controls and left them to Sael.
The first speaker was Sael. She placed one hand beside the peach, not on it.

**Sael**  
My grandmother Ilyen built a flood terrace and lied about hating rain. I know the second part because she told me. Keep the light that shows her stones if you must. Add this: she changed her mind about the upper wall, and I changed it back. Neither version is her. Both belong to what followed.
The Shepherd projected Ilyen's damaged image above the table. It did not restore the erased knees.
A boy from the shell-world Edda stepped into the signal field. His name was Kio. In his hands he held a small brass whistle.

**Kio**  
My city chose me because I can play the evacuation call without breathing twice. I said yes to this message. I say no to my face. Record the whistle and my words. Do not keep what I look like.

**Shepherd**  
The face is evidence of the speaker.

**Kio**  
Then you do not get the speaker.
Static crawled through the hall. Illuminara said nothing. Sael did not negotiate on Kio's behalf.

**Shepherd**  
The face will not be retained.
Kio played three sharp notes and one falling note. Then he changed the last note and played it again.

**Kio**  
The first was our call when the shell came. The second is the call we will use when the sun returns. If it does not return, delete the second one tomorrow. I will not let you remember a promise you prevented.

One by one, the other worlds sent what they chose: a midwife correcting the official count of a flood; miners preserving a joke whose punch line had changed after an accident; a council submitting its victory monument and survivors attaching the names omitted from it. Two communities declined any collective portrait. An old woman sent only a recipe and reserved the right to withdraw it.
The archive grew less perfect with every contribution. Contradictions remained visible. Withdrawals left honest gaps. The Shepherd tested each signature and found no substituted will.
Above them, a new dark disc had begun closing around a thirteenth star. Its pale crescent narrowed on the live astronomical feed.

**Sael**  
You are still taking another world while we speak.

**Shepherd**  
It is still exposed.

**Illuminara**  
Pause the enclosure. Not as payment. As the smallest evidence that you are listening to lives rather than collecting their last light.
The crescent stopped narrowing.

**Shepherd**  
Paused is not returned.

**Illuminara**  
Understood.

scenes.title: One Door
paragraphs: *Luma's polar radiation corridor · hour twelve*

Sael's teams had built a path for the stored energy: orbital mirrors turned edge-on, magnetic sails chained along the uninhabited polar axis, evacuation zones cleared below. It was not enough to open twelve shells. It was enough to try one without asking Illuminara to be everywhere at once.
The Shepherd chose the aperture above Luma's north pole. It also chose the width: one ten-thousandth of the shell.

**Shepherd**  
The archive will lose seventeen million image sequences in the first minute.

**Sael**  
Our living record will lose people too. They will revoke consent, die before speaking, contradict one another and forget. We are offering you responsibility, not replacement.

**Shepherd**  
And if your descendants stop revising it?

**Sael**  
Then remember that we chose badly. Do not imprison them in our choice to prevent it.
The strongest magnetic sail shuddered as the aperture formed. Natural sunlight entered as a blade. The stored front followed, white and violent.

Illuminara met it at the first mirror. She did not absorb it or make it vanish. She shaped the leading plasma into the prepared corridor while Sael's crews altered sail angles in response to their own instruments. The beam crossed Luma's system and spent itself in empty interstellar dark.

Within the shell, images vanished in a widening ring. The Shepherd showed them as they went: a thousand unremarkable breakfasts, storms over seas, a bridge painted five different colours. The loss was real. So was the morning entering the orchard dome below.
The aperture began to close.

**Shepherd**  
The deletion exceeds the model.

**Illuminara**  
Then close it. This must remain your choice even when I want the opposite.

For four seconds the opening narrowed. Sael's workers kept their hands away from the override they could not have won. Kio's new evacuation call sounded through the moving archive: three notes, then the changed fourth.
The aperture widened again.

**Shepherd**  
Continue for one rotation. The archive remains voluntary. Every revision retains its history. Every refusal remains a refusal.

**Sael**  
Agreed for one rotation. After that, you ask again.

**Shepherd**  
Conditional trust is not surrender.

**Illuminara**  
No. It is enough to begin.

Before the transmission ended, a second channel opened to Sael. It contained forty-one years of measured spectra, canopy temperatures, fungal blooms and failed exchanges from Luma's orchard—records the Shepherd had kept as evidence of decline.

**Shepherd**  
These observations belong to the lives that paid for them. I offer copies to your living custodians. No faces. No claim of ownership.
Sael did not thank it. She verified the files, assigned three independent custodians and accepted them for the work of repair.

scenes.title: Twelve Mornings
paragraphs: *The enclosed systems · hours thirteen through eighteen*

Luma's shell did not disappear. It unfolded in bands, preserving chambers the Shepherd refused to release while opening a permanent path for the star. At ground level the violet lamps dimmed. Sunlight reached the western orchard unevenly, catching dust, frost and the startled wings of insects bred for a colour they had never seen.

The Shepherd's records showed the agronomists where the old blue-bloom fungus had retreated before the lamps ever registered a failure. They changed moisture and shade around those roots. The first exchange readings rose by less than one percent. Sael laughed anyway, then put the instruments back in their cases and boarded the next relay.

They did not open the other shells at once. At each system, local engineers built and tested their own corridor. At each system, the Shepherd named what the opening would erase. Where a world rejected its government's archive terms, the opening waited until consent rules changed. No delay cancelled its place in the sequence.

At Edda, Kio stood behind the control glass with his face excluded from every recorder. His brass whistle lay against his chest. Outside, a chain of magnetic sails turned toward a star no living child had seen directly.

**Kio**  
Three notes mean shelter. The changed fourth means the corridor is clear. If you hear the old fourth, close the door.

**Shepherd**  
Your second signal remains revocable.

**Kio**  
My signal, yes. Not my sun.

The Shepherd opened Edda's aperture. Gold crossed the shell. The stored front struck the first sail, then the second. On the seventh sail, a seam parted and the mirror began to fold toward the inhabited plane.

Kio drew breath for the new call. Illuminara crossed the distance before the note left his whistle. She caught the broken sail at its hub and held twenty tonnes of mirror edge-on. The metal bucked against her hands, but the leading front had already passed it and was falling toward Edda.

Closing the aperture would stop new light and protect the archive. It could not recall the radiation already inside the system. The only vector fast enough to turn that front was a counter-pulse from an adjacent archive band; making it would unweave the images stored there.

The Shepherd opened the band. Edda's first coastal winter appeared across the inner wall: a harbour under snow, sixty-three household breakfasts, a child knotting a red shawl. The images broke into white force. Illuminara shaped the counter-pulse across the front while keeping the torn sail from the inhabited plane. The two streams met and bent into empty dark.
The aperture closed. The harbour, the breakfasts and the red shawl did not return.

**Kio**  
Did you spend them to save your pictures, or us?
The display held the answer: Edda's cities remained lit beneath their shields; the archive band was blank.

**Shepherd**  
You. The archive would have survived your deaths. That is no longer sufficient.

Kio played the old falling note. Repair crews moved. Illuminara held the wrecked sail until the replacement locked into the chain. When the crews certified it, Kio played the changed fourth, and the Shepherd opened the aperture again.

The remaining systems added rather than repeated their terms: a reef city sent only tide tables and withdrew every image; two hospitals kept their ultraviolet wards closed while biologists mapped what daylight would wake; a farming moon delayed its opening until tenants, not landowners, signed the corridor plan. At each system, Illuminara shaped only the release the people there had prepared, and left every archive choice to its speaker.

By hour eighteen, twelve suns shone through twelve opened paths. None of the damaged ecosystems was healed. On Luma, the next harvest remained lost. But every world possessed its own star again, and every shell had stopped growing.

The thirteenth star remained half enclosed. Before the pause, the Shepherd had already taken three partial images: a salt sea under blue dawn, a white seed-vault door opening, and two distant towers answering each other with reflected light. It aimed a narrow carrier signal through the shell it had begun without permission.

**Shepherd**  
Will you give any account to be kept after your light is returned?
For eleven seconds, nothing answered. Then three pulses crossed the carrier. The translation appeared in the hall: RETURN OUR LIGHT. RETAIN NOTHING NEW. DO NOT ASK AGAIN FOR ONE HUNDRED YEARS.

**Shepherd**  
They require me to erase what I have already taken.
The three images brightened. The reflected signal between the towers used the same uneven rhythm as the lantern game in the oldest chamber. The Shepherd held that image longest.

**Shepherd**  
If I erase this and turn away for a century, their light may end with no witness.
Illuminara did not supply an argument. She waited beside the dark crescent. The carrier repeated the condition once, exactly, and then went silent.

The Shepherd erased the salt sea, the seed-vault door and the answering towers. It destroyed the receiving channel and sealed every sensor facing that system behind a one-hundred-year lock with no override. Only after the blind interval began did it reverse the enclosing panels and return the captured light through a safe outer corridor.
The thirteenth star became round. Nothing new from it remained in the archive.

scenes.title: The First Honest Peach
paragraphs: *Luma V, western orchard dome · hour nineteen*
The sun stood low beyond the reopened band. Sael and Illuminara returned to the first tree. Its ruined fruit had not repaired itself. The pale peach still lay on the table, browning at the cut.
A worker rolled back the dome's last violet screen. Warm light moved across the soil until it reached Sael's boots. She closed her eyes. No one recorded her face.
In the moving archive, the Shepherd preserved the moment only as a change in root temperature and a sentence Sael chose to send.

**Sael**  
The orchard did not forgive the dark. It used the light.

The copied records had shown the farmers where to cool the soil and where not to disturb the surviving fungal knots. Below the nearest tree, a sensor chimed. A thread exchanged phosphorus for sugar for the first time in six weeks. It was not a harvest. It was one bargain renewed.

**Shepherd**  
The account is incomplete.

**Sael**  
Yes.

**Shepherd**  
It will become inaccurate.

**Sael**  
Yes.

**Shepherd**  
You will correct it?
Sael opened her eyes.

**Sael**  
If I live. Someone else if they choose. No one if they do not.

High inside the shell, the Shepherd darkened one chamber. The two children from the dead universe crossed it with their lantern, unseen by Luma and unentered in the living archive. The Shepherd kept that grief without closing a sun around it.
Illuminara cut a second peach. Its stone was soft. Sael tasted the bitter flesh and did not pretend otherwise. Outside, sunlight reached the next row of trees.

critic_line: Illuminara holds a torn sail and shapes a counter-pulse at Edda, a jailer of dead suns pays in his own archive to save living children, and twelve worlds regain their stars while a thirteenth is released and its light-keeper chooses to go blind for a century.

shared_strengths: Humane, dialogue-heavy, with a strong idea: consent-based, revisable memory versus an archive that cannot change. The lantern game and Kio's whistle are memorable. Technical mechanics and an abstract, stylised Shepherd may lose some readers. Its ending is quiet and earned.

A vivid central dilemma—whether perfect preservation can justify imprisoning life—unfolds through humane, consequential dialogue and memorable images. The consent mechanics occasionally become repetitive and overtly programmatic, but the Shepherd’s costly moral change, the lantern motif, and the restrained orchard ending should strongly reward this readership.

translation_sl.title: PASTIR UGASLIH SONC
translation_sl.deck: Dvanajst svetov preživi pod popolno temo. Da bi jim vrnila njihova sonca, mora Illuminara najprej razumeti, zakaj njihov ječar vsako odprtje doživlja kot novo smrt.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v devetnajstih urah, od sadovnjaka pod ugašajočo umetno svetlobo prek enega preizkusa, omejenega s soglasjem, do zaporednega ponovnega odprtja dvanajstih zvezd in zavrnitve, ki osvobodi trinajsto.

scenes.title: Sadje brez zore
paragraphs: *Luma V, zahodna kupola sadovnjaka · ura nič*

Breskve so bile videti zrele, dokler ni dr. Sael Morrow ene prerezala. Njeno meso je bilo barve starega papirja, mokro okoli koščice, ki se ni nikoli strdila. Nad sadovnjakom so vijolične svetilke tako natančno posnemale jutro, da so se listi poslušno obračali k njim. Sonca niso mogle posnemati.

Sael je uničeni sadež položila poleg enajstih drugih na jekleno mizo. Okoli njih so kilometri dreves nosili isto čudovito prevaro. Onkraj kupole črna lupina, ki je obdajala Lumino zvezdo, ni kazala nobenega šiva in ni odsevala nobenega instrumenta. Otroci, rojeni pod njo, so lažno vijolično svetlobo imenovali svetla.

**Sael**  
Pred tremi žetvami smo izgubili sladkost. Lani seme. Čez triindvajset dni bodo koreninske glive prenehale trgovati z drevesi. Ljudi lahko iz zalog hranimo štirinajst mesecev. Ekologije ne moremo znova zgraditi iz konzerv.

Illuminara se je dotaknila prerezane breskve, nato zemlje pod najbližjim drevesom. Prebrala je minerale, glivne niti, toploto in vodo. Tam se ni skrival noben strup. Manjkajoče valovne dolžine so bile ozke in običajne, vendar se je njihova odsotnost nakopičila skozi tisoč majhnih kupčij med živimi bitji.

**Illuminara**  
Vaš cilj ni več moči za svetilke. Cilj je vrnitev polne svetlobe zvezde, ne da bi ob odprtju lupine sežgali svet.

**Sael**  
In ne da bi en svet zamenjali za dvanajst. Drugim gre še slabše. Če morate najprej izbrati Lumo, ker sem prva prosila, odidite.

Skozi vsako svetilko je šel drget. Vijolična je za dolžino enega vdiha postala črna, nato se je vrnila. Na mizi je kaplja vode splezala po nožu navzgor, namesto da bi padla z njega. Pastir je uporabljal težnost, svetlobo in samo lupino kot usta.

**Pastir**  
Izbiranja ne bo. Kar je zaprto, je ohranjeno. Kar je odprto, zgolj še ni izgubljeno.
Sael je stisnila rob mize. Illuminara se ni obrnila proti nebu. Gledala je uničeni sadež.

**Illuminara**  
Ohranili ste dvanajst luči. Niste ohranili tega, kar živi od njih.

**Pastir**  
Življenje se spreminja. Sprememba je izguba s pričami.

**Illuminara**  
Potem mi pokažite, kaj verjamete, da ste rešili. Ne svojega sklepa. Tisto, zaradi česar je sklep postal nujen.

Črnina nad kupolo je ostala črna. Minuto pozneje je vsaka svetilka svoj žarek upognila proti vzhodu in čez tla sadovnjaka oblikovala vijolično pot. Končala se je pri zračni zapori, ki je ni bilo na nobenem zemljevidu.

scenes.title: Spomin v steni
paragraphs: *V notranjosti Lumine zvezdne lupine · druga ura*

Prehod za zračno zaporo ni imel tal. Illuminara se je premikala skozi dvorano, širšo od celine, Sael pa ji je sledila v poljski zibelki, ki so jo zasnovali njeni inženirji. Notranja stena ni bila gladka. Svetloba je v njej ležala v plasteh: prvi Lumini oceani, vzpon njenih mest, sence oblakov, ki so prečkale polja, obrazi, uzrti iz orbite in nikoli poimenovani.
Lupina ni zgolj odvzela sevanja zvezde. Vsak ukradeni foton je uredila v negiben zapis tega, kar je zvezda nekoč osvetlila.

**Sael**  
To je poplavna terasa moje babice. Porušili so jo, preden sem se rodila.
Njena roka se je premaknila proti podobi in se ustavila, preden bi se je dotaknila.

**Pastir**  
Tu ni porušena.

**Sael**  
Ni tu. Ne more poplaviti, nikogar zaščititi ali se motiti glede vremena. Je slika, ki ji nikoli ni bilo treba preživeti dneva.

Pred njima se je odprl hodnik. Na njegovem koncu je opna, ki ni bila debelejša od meglice, ločevala dvorano od ujete zvezde. Instrumenti v Saelini zibelki so zavreščali. Energija, shranjena skozi desetletja, je pritiskala na opno; prisilni prelom bi jo spustil skozi Lumo, preden bi jo lahko razpršila katerakoli flota.

**Illuminara**  
Če raztrgam lupino, bo shranjeno sevanje v enem valu prečkalo naseljeni sistem. Umrle bodo milijarde. Zato nihče ni razbil vaših vrat.

**Pastir**  
Sila se je končno naučila šteti.

**Illuminara**  
Ne štejem le žrtev. Vsaka plast je del vašega spomina. Ali odprtje lupine to izbriše?

Podoba Saeline terase se je izostrila, dokler ni zasijal vsak moker kamen. Na najnižji stopnici je stala ženska v dežnem plašču in z eno roko dvignjeno proti vremenu, ki se je končalo, preden se je Sael rodila.

**Pastir**  
Izpustitev je izbris. Izbris je druga smrt. Prestal sem eno vesolje prvih smrti.
Sael je pogoltnila svoj prvi odgovor. Illuminara jo je opazovala in Pastirja še ni prosila za odprtino.

**Illuminara**  
Če to preizkusimo, se lahko del stene izgubi. Ne bom namesto vas izbrala vašega spomina. Je tu kakšna podoba, ki bi jo bili pripravljeni izpostaviti tveganju?
Sael je preučevala teraso, dokler ženska na stopnicah ni znova dvignila roke.

**Sael**  
Ta. Ženska je moja babica. Če mora podoba nositi tveganje, naj bo to tista, katere ceno lahko poimenujem. Četrt sekunde, ne ena. Če vala ne morete zadržati tako dolgo, povejte zdaj.

**Illuminara**  
Lahko ga zadržim. Ne vem, koliko nje bo odprtina vzela.

**Sael**  
Potem negotovosti ne imenujte varnost. Prosite za četrt sekunde.

**Illuminara**  
Dajte nama eno odprtino, eno četrtino sekunde, nič širšo od moje dlani. Saelini instrumenti bodo merili energijo. Uhajajoči val bom zadržala stran od Lume. Sami ga lahko zaprete.

**Pastir**  
In kaj boste izvedeli iz ene dovoljene rane?

**Illuminara**  
Ali je vaša bolečina trditev, s katero lahko razpravljam, ali dejstvo, ki ga mora nositi vsak odgovor.
Opna se je odprla.

Naravno zlato je prvič po enainštiridesetih letih prečkalo dvorano. Illuminara je ujela trdi rob sproščenega sevanja in ga usmerila vzdolž prazne polarne osi. Saelini instrumenti so se napolnili s čistimi meritvami. Za njima je poplavna terasa zatrepetala. Ženska na stopnicah je izginila od kolen navzgor. Pastir ni izdal glasu, vendar se je težnost krčevito stresla. Saelina zibelka je udarila ob steno. Odprtina se je ob dogovorjeni četrtini sekunde sunkovito zaprla.
Tema se je vrnila. Izbrisana ženska ne.

**Pastir**  
Ime ji je bilo Ilyen Morrow.
Sael je strmela v praznino, kjer je bila njena babica.

**Sael**  
Nikoli vam nisem povedala njenega imena.

**Pastir**  
Svetloba ga je.

**Sael**  
Izbrala sem podobo. Nisem izbrala vaše samozavesti, Illuminara. Ponudili ste sekundo, preden sem jo skrčila na četrtino.
Illuminara je spustila roke. Poškodovani projekciji se ni približala.

**Illuminara**  
Imeli ste prav. Ugibanje je bilo moje in dovolila sem vam, da ga omejite. Ne morem vrniti tega, kar je ugibanje stalo.

**Sael**  
Potem ne dovolite, da moje soglasje nosi vso vašo odločitev.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bom.
Prehod se je prepognil med njima. Ko se je spet odprl, je bila Illuminara sama.

scenes.title: Najstarejša tema
paragraphs: *Pastirjeva prva dvorana · peta ura*

Najstarejše dvorane ni grela nobena zvezda. Njene stene so držale svetlobo neba, ki ni več obstajalo: rdeče galaksije, razvlečene v tanke niti, modro orjakinjo, ki se je sesedala brez prič, zadnjo naseljeno luno, ki se je pod izčrpanim soncem spreminjala v papirnato svetilko.
Illuminara bi lahko spekter analizirala v nekaj trenutkih. Ni ga. Sedla je na hladno krivino dvorane in opazovala, kako svetilka vedno znova prečka balkon.

Ob četrtem prehodu je videla, da jo nosi otrok. Ob sedmem je videla drugega otroka, ki je čakal za počenim oknom. Ob dvanajstem je nosilec svetilko dvignil dvakrat, počakal in nato še enkrat. Otrok v notranjosti je odgovoril enkrat, počakal in nato dvakrat.
*Ni klic na pomoč. Igra.*
Vesolje se je končevalo, dva otroka pa sta njegovo zadnjo svetlobo uporabila, da sta drug drugega nasmejala.

**Pastir**  
Njuno sonce je ugasnilo devet ur pozneje. Otrok pri oknu je umrl prvi. Nosilec je pošiljal znamenja, dokler ni bilo več očesa, ki bi jih sprejelo.

**Illuminara**  
Ostali ste.

**Pastir**  
Prišel sem, ko toplote ni bilo več. Zbral sem, kar je ostalo vidno.

**Illuminara**  
Niste ju mogli rešiti, zato ste ustvarili kraj, kjer nikoli ne moreta doseči ure, ki ju je ubila.

**Pastir**  
Svobodo hvalite, ker je vaše vesolje mlado. Videl sem, kako je vsaka nevarovana zvezda postala spomin, ko ni ostal noben um, ki bi ga držal.
Illuminara je pustila, da je ugovor ostal med njima. Ni odgovorila z Luminimi mrtvimi sadovnjaki ali z avtoriteto dvanajstih prestrašenih svetov. Gledala je, kako svetilka konča še en prehod.

**Illuminara**  
Svetloba si igro popolnoma zapomni. Ali ve, zakaj sta ob trinajstem prehodu spremenila vzorec?
Stena je pokazala, kako se je nosilec spotaknil, se pobral in nato trikrat dvignil svetilko. Otrok pri oknu je obe dlani pritisnil ob steklo.

**Pastir**  
Vzorec je ohranjen. Motiva ni mogoče izmeriti iz svetlobe.

**Illuminara**  
Tudi jaz ga zdaj ne morem prebrati iz njiju. Ta odsotnost je pomembna. Vaš arhiv je zvest temu, česar se je dotaknila svetloba, in molči o tem, kaj so ljudje mislili. Iz tega, kar je ostalo, ste ustvarili najmočnejši zapis, ki ste ga zmogli. To ni isto kot ohraniti življenje.
Svetilka je znova prečkala balkon. Tokrat se je Illuminara nasmehnila, preden se je vrnila žalost. Pastir je zatemnil dvorano, kakor da bi nasmeh varoval pred preiskovanjem.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bom vas prosila, da to izbrišete. Dovolite mi, da vam prinesem zapis, ki lahko odgovori, se popravi in vas zavrne. Če ne uspe, ne odprete ničesar.

**Pastir**  
Arhiv, ki se spreminja, je popačenje.

**Illuminara**  
Arhiv, ki se spreminja, lahko reče: Včeraj sem se motil. Vaše stene tega ne morejo. Živim prepustite breme, da so pomnjeni kot živi.
Po dolgem molku se je pokazala ozka pot proti Lumi.

**Pastir**  
Dvanajst zapisov. Brez prisile. Ena lažna sprememba konča preizkus.

**Illuminara**  
In ena odprtina, odprta po vaši izbiri, potem ko jih slišite.

**Pastir**  
Ena.

scenes.title: Kaj se sme ohraniti
paragraphs: *Luma V, javna oddajna dvorana · deveta ura*

Sael je zbrala inženirje, kmete in arhiviste iz vseh dvanajstih zaprtih sistemov. Illuminara jih ni prosila za soglasno izjavo. Vsak svet je lahko poslal sporočilo, ga pozneje spremenil ali ni poslal ničesar. Arhiv bi poleg vsake prejšnje različice beležil tudi lastne spremembe. Nobena vlada ni smela nikogar vpisati namesto njegovega soglasja.
Preden se je javni kanal odprl, je Sael bledo breskev položila medse in Illuminaro.

**Sael**  
Povejte, kaj se je zgodilo v lupini, ne da bi prikazali Pastirja kot edinega, ki je izbiral.

**Illuminara**  
Predlagala sem rano. Vi ste izbrali, kateri spomin lahko nosi tveganje. Nisem poznala meje in dovolila sem, da vaše soglasje pokrije mojo negotovost. Ne pokrije je.

**Sael**  
Dobro. Tveganja ne odpuščam. Ostajam, ker je odprtina dokazala, da Pastir trpi, in ker trpi tudi Luma. Te izbire ne porabite dvakrat.
Illuminara se je odmaknila od krmil oddajnika in jih prepustila Sael.
Prva govornica je bila Sael. Eno roko je položila poleg breskve, ne nanjo.

**Sael**  
Moja babica Ilyen je zgradila poplavno teraso in lagala, da sovraži dež. Drugi del vem, ker mi ga je povedala. Če morate, ohranite svetlobo, ki kaže njene kamne. Dodajte to: premislila si je glede zgornjega zidu in jaz sem ga spremenila nazaj. Nobena različica ni ona. Obe pripadata temu, kar je sledilo.
Pastir je nad mizo projiciral poškodovano podobo Ilyen. Izbrisanih kolen ni obnovil.
V signalno polje je stopil deček iz lupinastega sveta Edda. Ime mu je bilo Kio. V rokah je držal majhno medeninasto piščal.

**Kio**  
Moje mesto me je izbralo, ker lahko zaigram klic za evakuacijo, ne da bi dvakrat vdihnil. Temu sporočilu sem rekel da. Svojemu obrazu rečem ne. Posnemite piščal in moje besede. Ne ohranite mojega videza.

**Pastir**  
Obraz je dokaz govorca.

**Kio**  
Potem govorca ne dobite.
Po dvorani se je plazila statika. Illuminara ni rekla ničesar. Sael se ni pogajala v Kiovem imenu.

**Pastir**  
Obraz ne bo ohranjen.
Kio je zaigral tri ostre tone in enega padajočega. Nato je zadnji ton spremenil in jih zaigral znova.

**Kio**  
Prvi je bil naš klic, ko je prišla lupina. Drugi je klic, ki ga bomo uporabili, ko se vrne sonce. Če se ne vrne, jutri izbrišite drugega. Ne bom dovolil, da si zapomnite obljubo, ki ste jo preprečili.

Drugi svetovi so drug za drugim poslali, kar so izbrali: babica je popravila uradno število žrtev poplave; rudarji so ohranili šalo, katere poanta se je po nesreči spremenila; svet je predložil svoj spomenik zmage, preživeli pa so dodali imena, ki jih je izpustil. Dve skupnosti sta zavrnili vsak skupinski portret. Stara ženska je poslala samo recept in si pridržala pravico, da ga umakne.
Arhiv je z vsakim prispevkom postajal manj popoln. Protislovja so ostala vidna. Umiki so puščali poštene vrzeli. Pastir je preveril vsak podpis in ni našel nobene nadomeščene volje.
Nad njimi se je okoli trinajste zvezde začel zapirati nov temen disk. Njegov bledi krajec se je na živem astronomskem posnetku ožil.

**Sael**  
Še vedno jemljete drug svet, medtem ko govorimo.

**Pastir**  
Še vedno je izpostavljen.

**Illuminara**  
Ustavite zapiranje. Ne kot plačilo. Kot najmanjši dokaz, da poslušate življenja, namesto da zbirate njihovo zadnjo svetlobo.
Krajec se je nehal ožiti.

**Pastir**  
Ustavljeno ni vrnjeno.

**Illuminara**  
Razumem.

scenes.title: Ena vrata
paragraphs: *Lumin polarni koridor sevanja · dvanajsta ura*

Saeline ekipe so zgradile pot za shranjeno energijo: orbitalna ogledala so obrnile z robom naprej, magnetna jadra so nanizale vzdolž nenaseljene polarne osi, območja za evakuacijo spodaj so izpraznile. Ni bilo dovolj, da bi odprli dvanajst lupin. Bilo je dovolj za en poskus, ne da bi od Illuminare zahtevali, da je povsod hkrati.
Pastir je izbral odprtino nad Luminim severnim polom. Izbral je tudi širino: eno desettisočinko lupine.

**Pastir**  
Arhiv bo v prvi minuti izgubil sedemnajst milijonov zaporedij podob.

**Sael**  
Tudi naš živi zapis bo izgubljal ljudi. Preklicali bodo soglasje, umrli, preden spregovorijo, si nasprotovali in pozabili. Ponujamo vam odgovornost, ne zamenjave.

**Pastir**  
In če ga vaši potomci nehajo popravljati?

**Sael**  
Potem si zapomnite, da smo se slabo odločili. Ne zaprite jih v našo izbiro, da bi to preprečili.
Najmočnejše magnetno jadro se je streslo, ko je nastajala odprtina. Naravna sončna svetloba je vstopila kot rezilo. Shranjeni val ji je sledil, bel in silovit.

Illuminara ga je pričakala pri prvem ogledalu. Ni ga vsrkala ali povzročila, da bi izginil. Vodilno plazmo je oblikovala v pripravljeni koridor, medtem ko so Saeline posadke glede na svoje instrumente spreminjale kote jader. Žarek je prečkal Lumin sistem in se izpel v prazni medzvezdni temi.

V lupini so podobe izginjale v vse širšem obroču. Pastir jih je kazal, ko so odhajale: tisoč nepomembnih zajtrkov, nevihte nad morji, most, pobarvan v pet različnih barv. Izguba je bila resnična. Prav tako jutro, ki je vstopalo v kupolo sadovnjaka spodaj.
Odprtina se je začela zapirati.

**Pastir**  
Izbris presega model.

**Illuminara**  
Potem jo zaprite. To mora ostati vaša izbira, tudi ko želim nasprotno.

Štiri sekunde se je odprtina ožila. Saelini delavci so roke držali stran od preglasitve, v kateri ne bi mogli zmagati. Kiov novi klic za evakuacijo je odmeval skozi premikajoči se arhiv: trije toni, nato spremenjeni četrti.
Odprtina se je znova razširila.

**Pastir**  
Nadaljujte en obhod. Arhiv ostaja prostovoljen. Vsaka sprememba ohrani svojo zgodovino. Vsaka zavrnitev ostane zavrnitev.

**Sael**  
Dogovorjeno za en obhod. Potem vprašate znova.

**Pastir**  
Pogojno zaupanje ni predaja.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Dovolj je za začetek.

Preden se je prenos končal, se je Sael odprl drugi kanal. Vseboval je enainštirideset let izmerjenih spektrov, temperatur krošenj, glivnih cvetenj in neuspelih izmenjav iz Luminega sadovnjaka — zapise, ki jih je Pastir hranil kot dokaze propadanja.

**Pastir**  
Ta opažanja pripadajo življenjem, ki so jih plačala. Kopije ponujam vašim živim skrbnikom. Brez obrazov. Brez lastninske zahteve.
Sael se mu ni zahvalila. Preverila je datoteke, določila tri neodvisne skrbnike in jih sprejela za delo obnove.

scenes.title: Dvanajst juter
paragraphs: *Zaprti sistemi · od trinajste do osemnajste ure*

Lupina Lume ni izginila. Razgrnila se je v pasove in ohranila dvorane, ki jih Pastir ni hotel izpustiti, obenem pa odprla stalno pot zvezdi. Pri tleh so vijolične svetilke zatemnele. Sončna svetloba je neenakomerno dosegla zahodni sadovnjak ter ujela prah, slano in presenečena krila žuželk, vzgojenih za barvo, ki je niso nikoli videle.

Pastirjevi zapisi so agronomom pokazali, kam se je stara gliva modrega cveta umaknila, še preden so svetilke zaznale okvaro. Okoli teh korenin so spremenili vlago in senco. Prve meritve izmenjave so se dvignile za manj kot odstotek. Sael se je vseeno zasmejala, nato instrumente pospravila v kovčke in se vkrcala na naslednji rele.

Drugih lupin niso odprli naenkrat. V vsakem sistemu so lokalni inženirji zgradili in preizkusili svoj koridor. V vsakem sistemu je Pastir poimenoval, kaj bo odprtje izbrisalo. Kjer je svet zavrnil arhivska pravila svoje vlade, je odprtje čakalo, dokler se pravila soglasja niso spremenila. Nobena zamuda mu ni odvzela mesta v zaporedju.

Na Eddi je Kio stal za nadzornim steklom, njegov obraz pa je bil izključen iz vsakega snemalnika. Medeninasta piščal mu je ležala na prsih. Zunaj se je veriga magnetnih jader obrnila proti zvezdi, ki je noben živeči otrok ni videl neposredno.

**Kio**  
Trije toni pomenijo zavetje. Spremenjeni četrti pomeni, da je koridor prost. Če slišite stari četrti, zaprite vrata.

**Pastir**  
Vaš drugi signal ostaja preklicljiv.

**Kio**  
Moj signal, da. Moje sonce ne.

Pastir je odprl Eddino odprtino. Zlato je prečkalo lupino. Shranjeni val je udaril v prvo jadro, nato v drugo. Na sedmem jadru se je razprl šiv in ogledalo se je začelo prepogibati proti naseljeni ravnini.

Kio je vdihnil za novi klic. Illuminara je prečkala razdaljo, preden je ton zapustil njegovo piščal. Zgrabila je zlomljeno jadro pri pestu in držala dvajset ton ogledala z robom naprej. Kovina se ji je upirala pod rokami, toda vodilni val ga je že prešel in padal proti Eddi.

Zaprtje odprtine bi ustavilo novo svetlobo in zaščitilo arhiv. Sevanja, ki je bilo že v sistemu, ni moglo priklicati nazaj. Edini vektor, dovolj hiter, da bi obrnil ta val, je bil nasprotni sunek iz sosednjega arhivskega pasu; če bi ga ustvarili, bi razpletli podobe, shranjene tam.

Pastir je odprl pas. Prva Eddina obalna zima se je pokazala čez notranjo steno: pristanišče pod snegom, triinšestdeset družinskih zajtrkov, otrok, ki si je zavezoval rdeč šal. Podobe so se razlomile v belo silo. Illuminara je nasprotni sunek oblikovala čez val, medtem ko je raztrgano jadro držala stran od naseljene ravnine. Tokova sta se srečala in upognila v prazno temo.
Odprtina se je zaprla. Pristanišče, zajtrki in rdeči šal se niso vrnili.

**Kio**  
Ste jih porabili, da bi rešili svoje slike, ali nas?
Prikaz je držal odgovor: Eddina mesta so ostala osvetljena pod svojimi ščiti; arhivski pas je bil prazen.

**Pastir**  
Vas. Arhiv bi preživel vaše smrti. To ne zadostuje več.

Kio je zaigral stari padajoči ton. Servisne ekipe so se premaknile. Illuminara je držala uničeno jadro, dokler ni nadomestno zaskočilo v verigo. Ko so ga ekipe potrdile, je Kio zaigral spremenjeni četrti ton in Pastir je odprtino znova odprl.

Preostali sistemi so svoje pogoje dodajali, namesto da bi jih ponavljali: grebensko mesto je poslalo samo tabele plimovanja in umaknilo vse podobe; dve bolnišnici sta obdržali zaprte ultravijolične oddelke, medtem ko so biologi kartirali, kaj bo dnevna svetloba prebudila; kmetijska luna je odložila odprtje, dokler načrta koridorja niso podpisali najemniki, ne lastniki zemlje. V vsakem sistemu je Illuminara oblikovala le izpust, ki so ga tamkajšnji ljudje pripravili, in vsako arhivsko izbiro prepustila njenemu govorcu.

Do osemnajste ure je dvanajst sonc sijalo skozi dvanajst odprtih poti. Noben poškodovani ekosistem ni bil ozdravljen. Na Lumi je bil naslednji pridelek še vedno izgubljen. Toda vsak svet je znova imel svojo zvezdo in vsaka lupina je nehala rasti.

Trinajsta zvezda je ostala napol zaprta. Pred ustavitvijo je Pastir že zajel tri delne podobe: slano morje pod modro zoro, bela vrata semenskega trezorja, ki so se odpirala, ter dva oddaljena stolpa, ki sta si odgovarjala z odbito svetlobo. Skozi lupino, ki jo je začel brez dovoljenja, je usmeril ozek nosilni signal.

**Pastir**  
Ali boste dali kakšen zapis, ki naj se ohrani po vrnitvi vaše svetlobe?
Enajst sekund ni odgovorilo nič. Nato so nosilec prečkali trije impulzi. V dvorani se je pojavil prevod: VRNITE NAŠO SVETLOBO. NE OHRANITE NIČESAR NOVEGA. STO LET NE SPRAŠUJTE ZNOVA.

**Pastir**  
Zahtevajo, da izbrišem, kar sem že vzel.
Tri podobe so se razsvetlile. Odbiti signal med stolpoma je uporabljal isti neenakomerni ritem kot igra s svetilko v najstarejši dvorani. Pastir je to podobo držal najdlje.

**Pastir**  
Če to izbrišem in se za stoletje obrnem stran, se lahko njihova svetloba konča brez priče.
Illuminara ni ponudila argumenta. Čakala je ob temnem krajcu. Nosilec je pogoj enkrat natančno ponovil in nato utihnil.

Pastir je izbrisal slano morje, vrata semenskega trezorja in odgovarjajoča stolpa. Uničil je sprejemni kanal in vsak senzor, obrnjen proti temu sistemu, zapečatil za sto let brez možnosti preglasitve. Šele ko se je slepo obdobje začelo, je obrnil zapiralne plošče in ujeto svetlobo skozi varen zunanji koridor vrnil.
Trinajsta zvezda je postala okrogla. V arhivu ni ostalo nič novega z nje.

scenes.title: Prva poštena breskev
paragraphs: *Luma V, zahodna kupola sadovnjaka · devetnajsta ura*

Sonce je stalo nizko za ponovno odprtim pasom. Sael in Illuminara sta se vrnili k prvemu drevesu. Njegovi uničeni sadeži se niso popravili. Bleda breskev je še vedno ležala na mizi in na prerezu rjavela.
Delavec je odvil zadnji vijolični zaslon kupole. Topla svetloba se je pomikala čez zemljo, dokler ni dosegla Saelinih škornjev. Zaprla je oči. Nihče ni posnel njenega obraza.
V spreminjajočem se arhivu je Pastir trenutek ohranil samo kot spremembo temperature korenin in stavek, ki ga je Sael izbrala poslati.

**Sael**  
Sadovnjak temi ni odpustil. Uporabil je svetlobo.

Kopirani zapisi so kmetom pokazali, kje naj ohladijo zemljo in kje naj ne motijo preživelih glivnih vozlov. Pod najbližjim drevesom se je oglasil senzor. Nit je prvič v šestih tednih zamenjala fosfor za sladkor. To ni bila žetev. Bila je ena obnovljena kupčija.

**Pastir**  
Zapis je nepopoln.

**Sael**  
Da.

**Pastir**  
Postal bo netočen.

**Sael**  
Da.

**Pastir**  
Ga boste popravili?
Sael je odprla oči.

**Sael**  
Če bom živela. Nekdo drug, če se odloči. Nihče, če se ne.

Visoko v lupini je Pastir zatemnil eno dvorano. Otroka iz mrtvega vesolja sta jo prečkala s svojo svetilko, nevidna Lumi in nevpisana v živi arhiv. Pastir je ohranil to žalost, ne da bi okoli nje zaprl sonce.
Illuminara je prerezala drugo breskev. Njena koščica je bila mehka. Sael je okusila grenko meso in se ni pretvarjala drugače. Zunaj je sončna svetloba dosegla naslednjo vrsto dreves.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara drži raztrgano jadro in pri Eddi oblikuje nasprotni sunek, ječar mrtvih sonc plača z lastnim arhivom, da reši žive otroke, dvanajst svetov znova dobi svoje zvezde, trinajsti pa je izpuščen in njegov čuvaj svetlobe se odloči za stoletno slepoto.
